title: Hiking and monk singing and boys choir
text: Albert is a thoughtful guide with meticulous planning. You get exactly what he promises (and more). He was also open to alternative and figured out how I could listen to the monks singing, ride the funicular and hike all in th same trip. I preferred to smaller scenic hike to St Michael’s cross.
author: Lily_A

title: Top Notch !!
text: Easy ride from Barcelona, Albert is an expert, he exceeded our expectations and made our experience unique, we are forever grateful to Albert for making our day at Montserrat unforgettable.
author: Ivonne_A

title: Must do!
text: This was just an amazing day and the best part of our trip to Barcelona. Albert was an amazing guide, great communicator and he accommodated my son and I all afternoon. The location is magical.
author: 647jamiew
